title: metadata designer: a create flow saves the spec seed's placeholder binding when the author picks none — a dataset with no base object saves `object: example_object` and its reads are refused
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible authoring defect that contradicts the declared contract. **reach:** a public entry, the console's dataset designer in create mode, measured in Chromium against a live backend. **Family:** a create flow writes a placeholder the author never chose. objectui#12789 (PR #12806) is its first occurrence: a non-Latin Label named the item `field`. This is the second, so this card covers every placeholder the create seeds carry, with an enumeration pin.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The landing is the create flow's body builder, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/createBody.ts` (`buildCreateModeBody`, which spreads the spec seed under the draft), and the designer's save gating. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`) from the os-dev report on objectui#12789 (PR #12806), which does not change this. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens
- An author opens a new dataset, gives it a name and saves it without picking a base object; the box still reads "Select an object…".
- The save sends `object: "example_object"` and succeeds.
- No such object exists. The next analytics read is refused, and the console toasts "Analytics query refused: … reading "example_object" is not permitted".

## Measured
- Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm`, `--fresh`, with a writable package `com.qa.vrf` (namespace `qavrf`). Chromium on objectui `main` `8df2608`, and again at PR #12806's head `e4b532b`.
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/dataset/probe_ds?mode=draft&package=com.qa.vrf` sent the body `{"name":"probe_ds","label":"Probe Ds","object":"example_object","dimensions":[],"measures":[{"name":"count","aggregate":"count"}]}` and got 200, "Saved dataset 'probe_ds'".
- The next read was refused: `[Analytics] object-level read admission denied for "example_object"`.

## The contract (read from source)
- `@objectstack/spec` `kernel/metadata-create-seeds.ts`: `BUILTIN_METADATA_CREATE_SEEDS.dataset.object` is the placeholder `example_object` (`PLACEHOLDER_OBJECT`).
- That file's header says: "Each seed is a COMPLETE minimal valid object including placeholder identity (`name`/`label`/object binding); a create flow overrides those from user input."
- The designer's create flow spreads the seed under the draft. It does not override the object binding when the author picks none, and the save does not ask for one.

## Expected
- A create flow never saves a seed placeholder the author did not override. For a dataset, the save asks for a base object, as a field's lookup asks for its target ("Pick the object to link to"), instead of sending `example_object`.
- An enumeration pin over `BUILTIN_METADATA_CREATE_SEEDS` asserts that every placeholder identity a seed carries (`name`, `label`, object binding) is either overridden from user input or refused at save. The next seed added cannot carry a placeholder through silently.

**Dedupe** (open and closed):
- every objectui `domain:ui` card (2433 rows) plus the newest objectui issues, grepped for `example_object|PLACEHOLDER_OBJECT|create seed|createSeed|buildCreateModeBody|BUILTIN_METADATA_CREATE_SEEDS` and for a dataset placeholder or a dataset saved without a base object. The hits are objectui#12715, #12442, #4286 and #10696, all other subjects;
- positive control on the same rows: `flow designer`, 24 hits.

Dedupe words: dataset example_object placeholder seed, dataset save without base object, createSeed placeholder object binding, buildCreateModeBody seed spread.
